title: pelargonium capillare
intro: Pelargonium capillare, commonly known as Cape Geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pelargonium capillare include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
